text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you from the other day!
Um, have you seen Machan anywhere?
choice_data_list: I haven't, but... why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant, huff, wheeze*...
All right, that's the outer lap done! Let's head back to the track, Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Machan? What's with that white pigeon...?
Wait, is that bird...?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So Fluffy-san has gone to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: May I say goodbye to them one last time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Machan...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The pigeon had passed away. I didn't know what to do,
and the moment I looked away, she was gone...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's always been an eccentric girl, constantly wandering off on her own.
Maybe she just went off to bury it, but still—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's this air about her, like she might suddenly vanish somewhere far beyond reach one day... and it just made me so uneasy...

I'd had several chances to talk with Aston Machan over the past few days,
but had she ever given off that impression?

...Either way, she must be in shock.
I agreed to help look for her and headed off campus to search.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...And with that, all done.

Aston Machan was beneath the overpass—
the very place she had once napped beside "Fluffy-san."

As Aston Machan stood up, before her lay
a freshly made little mound of earth.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since you're white, Fluffy-san, do you prefer white flowers?
Or maybe red? There were some yellow ones over there too, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I should have at least asked what your favorite color was.
A mistake on Machan's part.

Aston Machan was remarkably composed.
Without a single trace of tears, she calmly spoke to the grave.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I took both videos and photos, you see.
Machan will never, ever forget you, Fluffy-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all, Aston Machan stands for safe and secure.
You are flying high and clear in the sky inside me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Why, it's you from before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I am an Umamusume, so naturally I have more muscle than a human.
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant...

text_block_list.text:
I confessed honestly that, having seen her disappear with the remains of her "friend" Fluffy-san,
I assumed she would be grieving.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is why you said "strong."
Indeed, many humans become sad when someone passes away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, Machan knows: life is something that flows.
The hospital taught me so.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a doctor, you see,
so Machan's playground was the hospital. Life flows through a hospital.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From upstream to downstream.
We are born, we drift along, and everyone inevitably reaches the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are no exceptions. Not Fluffy-san, not you... and not me.
We all must go to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is completely ordinary—like needing oxygen to breathe, like being unable to grasp the clouds, like the sun setting in the evening.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That is why it is not sad.

Whether she noticed I was rendered speechless or not,
she continued to speak smoothly and matter-of-factly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What is truly sad is being forgotten.
For me, or for you, to forget Fluffy-san completely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why the most important thing is a trace.
A trace that does not vanish even after one is gone.
—Suddenly, I remembered Aston Machan's words from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan's dream is to become a mascot.
...I had jumped to the conclusion that her wish for merchandise was merely an extension of wanting to stand out and be adored.

Judging by this, however, her reasoning was fundamentally different.
Beneath it lay something purely simple, quiet, and poignantly intense...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...What is the matter?
Have you turned to stone?
I suddenly felt an overwhelming urge to confirm her true intention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan is going to run in the exhibition meet tomorrow and do wonderfully,
so please come and watch.

—Afterward, the two of us searched for flowers to place on the grave.
In the end, she never put her answer into words.
